cover_headline: Goldman Sachs Upgrades India to Overweight, Sets End-2027 Nifty Target of 28,500
facts: Goldman Sachs upgraded Indian equities to overweight and set a Nifty target of 28,500 by end-2027, implying roughly 12 percent upside from current levels
Goldman forecasts Nifty earnings-per-share growth of 15 percent in both 2027 and 2028
Foreign ownership of Indian equities has fallen to a decade-plus low after a cumulative foreign investor selloff of $64 billion between 2024 and 2026

end.headline: Goldman Sachs Upgrades India to Overweight, Sets End-2027 Nifty Target of 28,500
end.line: Goldman set a Nifty target of 28,500 by end-2027, implying roughly 12 percent upside from current levels.
